scenarios: a repository layer reuses a blueprint by name from the data directory, recorded in the revision by hash; after the stale park the explicit rebuild pins exactly the digest recomputed of what is there and names the changes; a second rebuild changes nothing; the run resumed after it runs in the rebuilt revision
proof: blueprints are reusable definitions versioned by content; RebuildEnvironment re-captures and pins the exact digest (idempotent) and the run continues in it.
audit: MISSING before: no reusable definition, no rebuild.
limitations: blueprints by file, versioned by content hash only; a rebuild is for a run at rest.
